Second Level: If the i ssue remains unresolved, it may be escalated by lodging a formal grievance through the SUVIDHA Portal: https://suvidha.bhel.in/suvidha/. Responses will be provided in accordance with the defined escalation matrix.” 10-Delivery period-12_weeks from date of PO, However 02 week additional delivery period is acceptable .
